integrity_statement: Proof is analytic; the standalone exact-rational checker verifies small finite instances, not the infinite theorem. Numerical constants are approximations of uniquely characterized roots. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive Ewens parameter in the permutation-size limit; no uniform convergence or finite transition formula. Classical Ewens moment and Poisson–Dirichlet intensity formulas already imply the basic finite covariance identity; historical completeness of the new single-crossing classification is not guaranteed. Independent audit has not been conducted.
title: A unique macroscopic-cycle covariance crossover under the Ewens law
